title: Reviewer controls leave no evidence
statement: Controls for previewing or reviewing a lesson, such as free navigation, answer reveal and reset, leave mastery, rewards, completion and unlocks exactly as they were.
detail: The reading course plans' quality checklist marks reviewer isolation as universal: free navigation, answer reveal, reset and reviewer-only controls leave mastery, reward, completion and unlock records unchanged, so exploring a course can't mint a learner's achievements or alter progression (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/standards/student-course-quality/versions/2.0.0/GOLDEN-CHECKLIST.qmd`, Q011). The practice layer's app requirements include a reviewer mode that unlocks lessons without minting mastery evidence, and stamps earned under compressed calendars are marked non-evidence (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/practice-layer-spec.md`).
